definitions.explanation: Describes a position, area, or period where the people, stock, or defenses on hand are too few for what is needed. Used of staffing above all, but also of inventory and of weak points in a defense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}{薄|うす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{守|まも}り→守り：12250_mamori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}{薄|うす}な⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧サイド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{攻|せ}めた→攻める：02123_semeru⟧。
examples.english: They attacked the thinly defended right side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}{薄|うす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Coverage will be thin over the New Year holidays while staff are away, so please contact us early.

notes:
USAGE:
Most often used predicatively with なる — {手|て}{薄|うす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become short-handed) — and attributively as {手|て}{薄|うす}な. It describes the situation, not the people: saying a section is {手|て}{薄|うす} is not a criticism of the staff there.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}{薄|うす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become short of hands
- ⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}{薄|うす}だ: security is thin
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}{薄|うす}だ: stock is running low
- {手|て}{薄|うす}な⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧: hours with thin coverage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手厚|てあつ}い→手厚い：12802_teatsui⟧: generous, attentive — plentiful care or support, the natural antonym.
